answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making each identity earn its voice through unique, verifiable work before it can transact. A new identity must complete distinct, checkable tasks whose outputs are cryptographically bound to it, like grain in cedar, no two proofs are interchangeable. Honest agents pay this cost once and gain a crystal-clear reputation, while an attacker must redo the full workload for every fake identity, so spawning a thousand ivory-tower sockpuppets costs a thousand times the work, and misbehaviour forfeits the accumulated work.
